newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia dlr fall backs GDP forecast - Evans.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia dlr fall backs GDP forecast - Evans.

text.p: Australian Treasury secretary Ted Evans said on Monday the weakening of the Australian dollar in the past few months had consolidated economic growth forecasts.
"The exchange rate change, we believe, will be quite significant in terms of consolidating that forecast of four percent growth in the non-farm sector," Evans told a parliamentary committee.

The Australian dollar has fallen from US$0.8000 in March to a current level around US$0.7400. In its 1997/98 budget, the Australian government forecast economic growth of 3.75 percent for the fiscal year to June 30, 1998.
